title: TOPIK II (intermediate) vocabulary — NIKL grade B

sourceNotes.NIKL-B: 국립국어원 「한국어 학습용 어휘 목록」 (2003), grade B (2단계). Homonym numbers as in that list.
sourceNotes.order: By the list's frequency rank (unranked proper nouns last). Words already in the TOPIK I deck with the same meaning are left out; words listed twice with different parts of speech appear once.
